name: Abe Goodkind
role: Traveling salesman for Wise & Goodkind, Bismarck liquor and cigar dealers
bio: Abe Goodkind traveled for Wise & Goodkind of Bismarck, calling on Medora's liquor and cigar dealers from 1884 through 1885. In March 1884 the firm gave Roberts & Co. sole rights to sell its Far West cigar in Little Missouri. The paper reported his visits regularly, describing him promoting the Far West, Our Pet and El Mapa Mundi brands, once in a mocking imitation of his accent.
